SASBDB entry SASDAQ2  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDAQ2/)

Bovine ubiquitin (EMBL Hamburg "Standard proteins" project), 40 mM sodium acetate, 150 mM
NaCl, pH 5.5, 10 degC, extrapolated to infinite dilution. SASBDB lists no publication.
Files:
  experimental_data/SASDAQ2.dat    SASBDB media/intensities_files (q in nm^-1)
  SASDAQ2_fit1.fit                 SASBDB media/fitting_files (CRYSOL, q in A^-1)
  SASDAQ2_fit1_model1.pdb          SASBDB media/pdb_file (identical to PDB 1UBQ, protein atoms)
  1UBQ.pdb                         files.rcsb.org, for the comparison (602 ATOM records equal)
SASDAQ2 has two fits: fit1 CRYSOL against 1UBQ (chi2 4.009; used) and fit2 DAMMIF (14.23; not
used). No file was modified. The fitting script states the conditions it takes from the
entry; there is no paper to consult.
